scripts.dev: npm run build:local:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "SERVER,CLIENT,RELOAD" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:reload"
scripts.dev:with:built:server: npm run build:server && npm run build:local:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "SERVER,CLIENT,RELOAD" -c "blue,green,magenta" "cross-env ENABLE_LIVE_RELOAD=true node public/index.js" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:reload"
scripts.dev:with:built:client: npm run build:local:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "SERVER,RELOAD" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:reload"
scripts.dev:server: cd ./server && cross-env ENABLE_LIVE_RELOAD=true npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
